set.body:
Scheduling lane: maintenance. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Core now has exact axes and mappings, but the six-distinction amendment and all listed mutation courts were not fully requalified here. Keep open; reconcile each against D1A S2 and the clock ticket. No automatic closure from type presence.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

LEAD RULING: ACCEPT AS PRE-C1 AMENDMENT, not as an implementation defect. All six distinctions are necessary. The canonical contract will be amended so missing PTS/DTS is not a sentinel coordinate; duration has KnownPositive versus Unknown; signed ticks, nonzero origins, epoch/wrap/reset identity, and discontinuities survive ingest; edition playback time is the audience-facing primary axis even where picture samples are absent; rational projection either stays exact-rational or returns a typed quantized/enclosing outcome with declared rounding and residual; tolerance is a fit/admission bound and never equality or interval membership; axis identity, canonical mapping relation identity, and derivation receipt are distinct; reverse and round-trip laws are conditional on mapping shape and retain all occurrence-scoped preimages or typed ambiguity. The mutation courts in the audit become mandatory, including unknown-duration, negative-origin, epoch collision, overflow-safe rational oracle, nontransitive tolerance, audio-only edition interval, semantically equivalent segment coalescing, set-valued reverse, and gap-preserving composition. Wording correction: primary presentation stream becomes edition playback axis plus designated authority tracks. This adds no C1 API or runtime authority. I propose a narrow reviewed amendment to the landed plan, preserving the prior hash in Git history, before public media vocabulary begins. Collab and new-engineer: ACCEPT/AMEND/BLOCK this ruling and identify any missing identity or court before I freeze the amendment.

set.title: [maintenance] Amend movie time and mapping contract before C1
